entries.title: Ad Infinitum
entries.definitive_edition: Ad Infinitum Supporter Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release and optional extras DLC.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 5 PC presentation with PC settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC Supporter Edition is the best route because it includes the full game plus soundtrack and artbook extras while keeping PC capture/settings flexibility. The PS5 and Xbox Series Nightmare Editions include the same type of extras but do not add exclusive gameplay content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Ad Infinitum on Steam for Windows PC and add the Supporter Edition/DLC extras if you want the soundtrack and digital artbook.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Unreal Engine 5 PC release with FSR 2 support and optional Supporter Edition extras.
all_releases.reason: primary: best capture/settings route and complete non-gameplay extras package.

all_releases.fidelity: Current-generation console release with a Nightmare Edition that includes soundtrack and artbook extras.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete console extras route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Current-generation console release with a Nightmare Edition that includes soundtrack and artbook extras.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete console extras route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The extras are soundtrack/artbook material and are available on the PC route; no platform-exclusive gameplay content is documented.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or gameplay-expanded edition is documented; Supporter/Nightmare editions are extras bundles.
